abstract.text: Follow one Project from a first place to a planned visit.

inlineContent.text: From the Map, open Dashboard → Add Project. Give the Project a name.
Open Dashboard → Context and select the new Project.
Open Dashboard → Current Project. Add the Locations the team needs to visit. Use Regions and Layers if the area has distinct sections or levels.
Create an Activity for the upcoming visit. Add a Route using the Project Locations as Stops, then create an Assignment for the person or team following it.
Select the Activity and optional Assignment in Context. Return to the Map to follow the route and open Location details.
When the work is over, archive the Activity. Keep the Project and its places for the next visit.

abstract.text: Learn how to organize places and work in LinkMap on iOS and the web.
Follow the existing iOS guides for setting up Projects, organizing places, planning work, and sharing. For differences between the iOS app and web map, see
LinkMap is available as an iOS app and a web map. Both can show the Projects and places available to you, but account access and available actions differ.
Use LinkMap to plan places and shared work from the Map.
The iOS app starts on the Map. Use it to set up Projects, plan Activities, and share places with collaborators.
